## Content
SUNNY mathematical mandate guard/capability audit, October31 2026. Current direct user mathematical mandate supersedes image hunting; old Favorites plan retained as historical in docs/HUMMBL_PLAN.md. Actual SuperJev jev-1.14.0 chose artifact-bound guards (0.94) and separately directed native residual derivation and all-nonrejected candidate-set prediction. All24 requested plugins reconciled in docs/evidence/mandate-plugin-execution.json and the current docs/PLUGIN_CAPABILITIES.md addendum, separating current/earlier runtime successes, failed runtimes, method-only use and unavailable inputs. Actual checks: six original/snapshot byte comparisons for five attachment occurrences/three unique content hashes plus authority record; nine independent source/arithmetic checks including six exact indexed TOL spans and original hashes; five focused actual prediction tests passed. Two fresh project Proofline packages valid, two MightShape evidence sets PASS; repeated-source and no-human-participant warnings remain. Sefirot ten-lens review is host-adapted and not ten independent votes or religious/mathematical proof. Mathbox native run002 inputs/outputs hash checked, run001 historical after corrected same-content GG source occurrence binding. New exact connected result: E/K=256/243 equals normalized reverse-five fifths; forward-seven normalized fifths is2187/2048 and differs by531441/524288, requiring bridge32768/32805 to retain16/15. Jev's false group-membership prediction was retained and exactly refuted by D_f^-2 U_f^-3=256/243. Across144words in the recovered optional12candidate family, eight shared word addresses map to four common addresses; no unique global orientation elected, no blind empirical success. TOL scalar endpoint cannot reconstruct both protected RL/LR histories. Actual source refresh previously overwrote four current-direction fields; root fixed preservation and retained before/after evidence. Raw input retention alone did not ensure active incorporation; no inference all inputs ever acquired/neverlost. AgentProof existing receipt verifier actually returned receipt_valid:true, repository MATCH,0checkedfiles; original two child commands failed. New isolated actual-file snapshot was prepared, but automatic PreToolUse CompText Guard rejected prerequisite Git baseline commit: git commit requires explicit release scope. No new capture child started, no bypass, old receipt preserved. No services/browsers/new instrumented Codex children started by this audit. Universal/generational geometry, complete account acquisition, independent phase observables and blind prospective validation remain unfinished. Stable detailed checks: docs/evidence/mandate-independent-review.json, mandate-input-preservation.json, mandate-derivation-proofline-result.json, mandate-agentproof-blocked.json. Files/native records remain source-role-qualified; hashes are scoped integrity, not truth or empirical probability.
